instruction: Remove all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory tree that were last modified 60 days ago

parameters.command: mkdir -p /tmp/test_files/old_files /tmp/test_files/recent_files && touch /tmp/test_files/old_files/old_file1.txt /tmp/test_files/old_files/old_file2.txt /tmp/test_files/old_files/old_file3.log /tmp/test_files/recent_files/recent_file1.txt /tmp/test_files/recent_files/recent_file2.txt && find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f -exec touch -d '60 days ago' {} \; && find /tmp/test_files/recent_files -type f -exec touch -d 'now' {} \;

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'BASE_DIR="/tmp/test_files"; OLD_FILES_DELETED=true; old_file_count=$(find "$BASE_DIR" -type f -mtime 60 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$old_file_count" -ne 0 ]; then OLD_FILES_DELETED=false; fi; RECENT_FILES_KEPT=false; recent_file_count=$(find "$BASE_DIR" -type f -mtime -60 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$recent_file_count" -ge 2 ]; then RECENT_FILES_KEPT=true; fi; if $OLD_FILES_DELETED && $RECENT_FILES_KEPT; then echo "Success: The task was completed correctly."; else echo "Failure: The task was not completed correctly. Old files (60 days): $old_file_count, Recent files (<60 days): $recent_file_count"; fi'

include: Success: The task was completed correctly.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that requires deleting files older than 60 days. Setup creates old_files (modified 60 days ago) and recent_files (modified now). Evaluator verifies old files are deleted while recent files remain. Using inline bash command for evaluation to check file deletion status.
metadata.verification_details: The evaluation checks: (1) no files with modification time of exactly 60 days ago remain in /tmp/test_files directory tree (using 'find -mtime 60'), (2) at least 2 files with modification time less than 60 days ago still exist (using 'find -mtime -60'). This verifies the agent correctly identified and deleted only files modified exactly 60 days ago based on actual timestamps, not directory structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies instruction requirements using modification time checks
Uses 'find -mtime 60' to verify no files exactly 60 days old remain (correctly identifies files to be deleted)
Uses 'find -mtime -60' to verify recent files (< 60 days) are preserved (at least 2 files remain)
Logic flow is sound: checks both deletion of old files AND preservation of recent files
Bash command correctly uses BASE_DIR='/tmp/test_files' to check entire directory tree as specified in instruction
